name: Ikusa Otome Valkyrie G ~Ikusa Otome-tachi no Tasogare~
original_name: 戦乙女ヴァルキリーG～戦乙女達の黄昏～
source:
Midgard is still in chaos. Duke, who used to be a boss of a monster group, tries to establish his kindgom in ruined Midgard. Aaliyah, Hildegarde, and Fefnir still work as his sex slaves. One day, Leia comes back from heaven. Leia actually can't forget Duke and comes back in the name of "protecting people in Midgard". Duke is happy to see her again, but a battle for Duke breaks out...

[From ErogeShop]
